title: charge
description: The four-valued word of a meme: two marks (positive, negative) drawn independently over a lossless evidence carrier. Four readings of value [positive, negative]: [F,F]=absurd (⊥, no side); [T,F]=potential (positive only); [F,T]=active (engaged, negative only); [T,T]=stable (⊤, told both). Knowledge order: absurd ↕ stable. Truth order: active ↔ potential. Evidence accumulates and is never discarded.

value.description: The two independent marks [positive, negative]. Determines the charge phase: absurd [F,F], potential [T,F], active [F,T], stable [T,T].

evidence.description: The lossless carrier [positive-witnesses, negative-witnesses]. Never discarded; accumulates all witnesses.
